notes.title: 1.1.3 update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the game could become unprogressable if the effect of the Anubis Sword was triggered during battle without equipping Offensive Magic.
- Fixed a bug affecting the data of enemies that used the special skill Transform.
- Fixed an issue where the wrong character icon was displayed when the language setting was set to English.
- Fixed fonts that were not displaying correctly.
- Fixed various minor issues.

notes.title: DOKAPON! Sword of Fury 1.1.2 update
notes.content: [h1]Version 1.1.2 Now Live![/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of DOKAPON! Sword of Fury![/p][p]In response to strong player feedback, we’ve made adjustments to NPC behavior in Version 1.1.2![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396435/c919dd5f180939ad29dc6f3348e7b309538521a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Update Details[/h2][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]  New NPC Behavior Types Added![/h3][p]　You can now choose an NPC behavior type at game start or during play.[/p][p]　In addition to the original Type A, we’ve added Type B, which is more active and plays at a faster tempo.[/p][p]　This can be changed via "Switch" in the in-game Settings menu for each player.[/p][p]　Note: Type B is now the default. Even old save data will load with Type B.[/p][p][/p][h3]  Color Variations Now Shown in Battle![/h3][p]　Character color variations are now reflected during combat as well as on the field.[/p][p][/p][h3]  Improved UI![/h3][p]　New icons now clearly show which player controls each village, even when using the same character.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]　Fixed an issue where the battle effect on the field was not displaying correctly.[/p][p]　Fixed font rendering issues in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for playing DOKAPON! Sword of Fury![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.1.1 update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where button settings could become incorrect after a rock-paper-scissors match with Peddler Gametz.
- Resolved a UI display issue that could occur during battles with players using different button display settings.
- Fixed a bug where the UI did not display correctly when the language was set to Simplified or Traditional Chinese and Portrait Effects were set to Dot.
- Addressed a problem where player icons were not displayed properly when an additional color was selected.
- Fixed various minor issues.

notes.title: DOKAPON! Sword of Fury Update 1.1.0
notes.content: [h1]Version 1.1.0 Now Live![/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of DOKAPON! Sword of Fury![/p][p]In response to player feedback, Version 1.1.0 is now available![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396435/c1caf8231f69905088256919fe023cf04bab1ad5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Update Details[/h2][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]   Same-Character Battles Now Supported![/h3][p]    At game start, multiple players can now select the same character.[/p][p]    Enjoy matches with no stat differences by having everyone choose the same character![/p][p]    Three new color variations have been added for characters on the field.[/p][p][/p][h3]   Transform Duration Limit for Darkling Added as a "Secret"![/h3][p]    When using a Contract to transform into a Darkling, you can now set a Transform Duration Limit.[/p][p]    This can be adjusted in the Secret settings.[/p][p]    Note: The default is set to 15 days. If you'd prefer to play without limits, switch to No Limit.[/p][p][/p][h3]   Cross-Language Online Battles Now Supported![/h3][p]    Online matches are now possible between players using different language settings.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Language Support[/h2][p]The following languages are now supported:[/p][p]    Simplified Chinese[/p][p]    Traditional Chinese[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]    Fixed a bug that could halt progress when battles occurred at the "Entrance to the Demon World".[/p][p]    Several minor issues have also been resolved.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for playing DOKAPON! Sword of Fury![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.0 Update – Coming Soon
notes.content: [h2]Upcoming Update: Ver.1.1.0 Preview[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that Ver.1.1.0 of DOKAPON! Sword of Fury is on its way! This update will introduce several new features and enhancements designed to make your gameplay even smoother and more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Language Support[/h2][p]The in-game UI and subtitles will soon support two additional languages:[/p][p][/p][p]- Simplified Chinese[/p][p]- Traditional Chinese[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to delivering a comfortable and accessible experience to players around the world![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p]Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in Ver.1.1.0:[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Mirror Matches Now Possible![/b][/p][p]  Multiple players can now choose and play as the same character in battle.[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Transformation Time Limit for Darkling[/b][/p][p]  You’ll be able to set a custom maximum duration for transformations triggered by using a Contract.[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Cross-Language Online Battles[/b][/p][p]  Multiplayer support now extends across different language settings—enjoy seamless online matches with players globally, regardless of language![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’re looking forward to these additions as much as we are![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of DOKAPON! Sword of Fury![/p]

notes.title: 1.0.4 update
notes.content:
- When playing online matches, the "Text Speed," "Movement Speed," and "Speed Multiplier" are now unified according to the host's settings and can be adjusted.
Please note that the client-side settings will be changed to match the host's settings, and these settings will be carried over after the match ends.
- Fixed an issue where, in the Pionnier, players could occasionally encounter unconfigured monsters or experience progression blocks during monster encounters.
- Fixed an issue in the Weekly Ranking of Online Mode where progression would halt until a CPU-controlled player (formerly a human player) pressed a button.
- Fixed an issue where players in the Drunk state could become unable to progress while in the casino.
- Fixed a bug in Chapter 10 where, under specific conditions, the game would become unresponsive at the start of a turn, preventing further progress.
- Fixed an issue where voice lines would not play correctly during certain events.
- Fixed various minor issues.

notes.title: 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
- Improved an issue in online multiplayer where, when searching for groups, players could sometimes not be found due to differences in their regions.
- Improved online multiplayer by allowing some settings to be changed on a per-player basis. Please refer to page 34 of the manual for details.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the X (Y) button during command selection in battle also triggered fast-forward; fast-forward will no longer occur.
- If your audio is not playing correctly, please post detailed information about your situation and your usage environment here.
https://www.sting.co.jp/bugreport-00fvzo78fio3ttbgz53n

notes.title: 1.0.2 update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where enabling the button swap setting inadvertently swapped the button layout displayed during battles and rock-paper-scissors. Please note that with this update, the layout will now match that of the actual controller.
- Fixed an issue where adjusting the BGM volume in settings did not affect the movies.
- Fixed an issue where keyboard controls would not work in certain situations.
- Fixed various minor issues.
- When starting online play, matching may fail due to version differences. Please make sure you are running the latest version.

notes.title: 1.0.1 update
notes.content:
・Improved an issue where audio may not play correctly.
・Fixed a problem where settings were not saved under certain conditions. Due to this update, some settings may revert to their initial values when resuming the game, so please be cautious. When loading data from "Continue" in "Standard Mode," the settings from the title screen will now continue as is.
・Fixed the opening movie that plays when the language is set to English.
